assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 3D JRPG visual target concept artwork for the original life simulation "Hourglass of Life".
Primary request: Take the attached original town and resident designs and make a polished real-time 3D Japanese story RPG visual target, with the appealing anime-model look and vibrant welcoming town atmosphere of modern Trails in the Sky the 1st / the 2nd. Original cast and town, not those games' characters or locations.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing town layout and everyday life reference. Image 2 is the EXACT eight original residents' identity, hairstyle, age, clothing and palette reference. Image 3 is Nagisa's shape/wardrobe reference.
Scene: A small sunny neighborhood courtyard, with a bakery/cafe on the right, an open repair workshop in the back, and a family house on the left, connected by a walkable stone path. The eight residents are visible in varied normal everyday activities: Nagisa with chestnut bob and olive shirt/rust apron carries a cup outside the cafe; Ryo with tousled dark hair and navy overshirt builds a small town model with Rin in yellow short overalls at a table by the family house; gray-haired bespectacled Osamu with a dark teal apron repairs a small wooden radio in the workshop; silver bobbed Fumi in mustard cardigan holds her camera near the flowers; ponytailed Maho in a salmon apron works behind the bakery window; dark-haired Ritsu with headphones around his neck sits on a teal-and-wood bench with a book; brown-haired Aoi with olive jacket, cream hoodie and backpack walks down the path.
Style/medium: The image must convincingly look like an actual high-quality REAL-TIME 3D anime JRPG environment and anime polygon characters, not a 2D painted illustration. Deliberate 3D geometry, clean perspective, modeled hair clumps, slim six-head-tall adults and four-head child, expressive anime eyes, crisp cel-shaded faces, 2-3 shadow tones, soft ambient occlusion at contacts, clean diffuse cloth and wood materials, subtle outlines, no toy proportions. Stylish rounded forms but anatomically coherent limbs. Vivid azure sky and leafy green trees, warm cream plaster, terracotta and slate blue roofs, teal furniture, brass details.
Composition: Wide landscape 16:9 game environment view, moderately elevated three-quarter camera but NOT isometric miniature/diorama. Walkable human-scale spaces with room between figures. Characters large enough to read hairstyles and body language. A glimpse of hills and town beyond. Natural asymmetry, original architecture faithful to the reference uses.
Lighting: bright late-morning warm sunlight with cool soft shadows, restrained bloom, legible faces, rich but controlled color.
Text: none.
Constraints: Exactly these eight original residents, clear age and height differences, maintain their identities and clothes from reference. Hands actually meet cups, table, book and repair surface. Feet touch pavement; seated body rests on bench. No HUD, no text, no logos, no watermark, no magic, no weapons, no copied franchise characters. This is concept art, not a screenshot claim.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 3D anime JRPG character visual target, three-view concept sheet.
Primary request: Reinterpret Nagisa, the woman shown in the supplied original turnaround, as a beautifully modeled, finished real-time 3D anime character of a modern Japanese story RPG such as Trails in the Sky the 1st / the 2nd. Keep her original design.
Input image: original Nagisa turnaround is an IDENTITY and CLOTHING reference only. Do NOT copy its illustration medium, brushwork, drawn outlines, shading style or layout.
Subject: the same friendly adult woman, 1.65m, about six heads tall, short rounded chestnut-brown bob with side fringe, warm amber anime eyes, olive-green collared shirt with sleeves rolled just below the elbows, rust-orange full apron with two pockets, waist ties and brass buttons, cream rolled-cuff straight trousers, brown low shoes. Adult face, gently pointed chin, shoulders and torso proportioned like a believable slim adult, not a doll or baby. Both hands with five fingers.
Rendering is crucial: This must unmistakably be a genuine 3D GAME CHARACTER RENDER on a plain light gray studio background, as if rendered in a game engine. Solid mesh hair with individually modeled chunky tapered locks, crisp polygon surfaces and physically coherent three-dimensional volume, large hand-authored anime iris textures, smooth cel-shaded face and softly modeled nose, narrow smooth cel shadow bands, cloth modeled in broad simple folds. PBR diffuse cloth, subtle ambient occlusion at collar and apron seams, shadows projected onto floor, clean specular sheen on shoes and brass. Modern polished anime 3D JRPG rendering, not photorealism, not western cartoon, not painterly illustration, not hand drawn, no sketch strokes, no paper grain, no fabric noise, no miniature toy.
Composition: Three full-body models of the EXACT same character evenly spaced on a wide clean sheet: FRONT at left, THREE QUARTER at center, BACK at right. Same height, ground line and neutral relaxed A-pose with arms 20 degrees apart. No crops. 50mm lens and low perspective distortion. The center view clearly shows 3D depth in the bob, nose, hands and apron. Soft neutral studio environment, key light above left and weaker cool fill, no scenery. Enough negative space between models.
Constraints: Exact original costume and colors from reference, age and facial identity preserved, original character unrelated to the source franchise's cast. No text, labels, HUD, logo, watermark, accessories, weapons or changes to outfit. Production art reference only, not a claim of a completed mesh.
